why: Boards of our own: a PCBench board with an exact patch (tools/variants/ID.patch, a unified diff of PCBs/BASE/processed.kicad_pcb at the PCBench commit named), made by tools/apply_variant.py and prepared and routed as the others are. Only the patch is shipped, never the board. A variant joins the tiers it names.

variants.why: Removes the F.Mask text "Exsisto nimis piger deficere." beside U103: it overlaps pins 8, 9 and 11 and bares pads of many nets, so no track leaves those pins without a mask bridge, and the designer's own routing adds them (tools/netcheck.py). Without it the board routes clean (2026-11-06: 12 s at 120 s, 78 vias).
